name: message
title: player:message
lead: What shows on this player's screen: the calls `ui` has, for them alone, plus their own menu and overlay. Sends a chat line to this player alone; `color` is for the words that did not pick one. Chat is not part of the screen, so it is not in `ui`.

usedIn.quote: player:message("Walk around, then type /spawn to return to the gold block.", "aqua")
reads their name; `player.ui.title` shows them a title; `player:message`
player:message(`Walk onto the gold plates! Your best is {best}.`, "gold")
player:message(`Walk onto the gold plates! Your best is {best}.`, "gold")
player:message(`Your best time is {string.format("%.1f s", best)}.`, "green")
player:message(`Your best time is {string.format("%.1f s", best)}.`, "green")
player:message("Walk around, then type /spawn to return to the gold block.", "aqua")
